messages:
harper: Quick postmortem follow-up from the vendor outage retro. We keep seeing three repeatable failure modes: control-plane auth rate collapse, model-registry throttling during cold starts, and cross-region config skew. Need concrete owners, a minimal sprint plan, and a recheck cadence. Who can pick items?
zach: I can take the control-plane/auth piece. Short plan: add client-side leaky-bucket + per-client soft-throttle, widen exponential backoff, and implement a short-lived local auth cache to absorb bursts. Deliverable: runbook + canary harness. ETA: 8 working days.
mira: I'll own vendor contact + KMS coordination. Immediate actions: request detailed rate-limits from vendor, confirm escalation contacts, and reserve a KMS rotation slot with sec for the fallback key. Blocking: need vendor contact for test tokens.
leo: I'll pick model-registry throttles and config skew. Proposal: 1) prefetch warmer that runs after deploys; 2) serve last-known-good manifest on registry errors; 3) periodic config-diff check across regions with auto-rollback if drift > 3 keys. Timeline: 1 sprint + 3 days for canary.
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-10421: "vendor-dep-repeatables/mitigation-epic" with checklist and assignee fields. Link: https://redwood.internal/INF-10421. Default due: 2027-11-10.
harper: Thanks. Let's define success metrics up-front: a) incident recurrence down by >=70% for the next 90 days, b) synthetic P99 spike suppression >=50%, c) <5 impact-minutes/week for the affected customers once rolled out. Add those to INF-10421.
zach: Adding an initial fallback snippet to the ticket: ```json
{"fallback_order":["inproc-cache","registry-readonly","degraded-mode"],"retries":{"max":5,"backoff_ms":[100,250,600,1500,3500]},"circuit_breaker":{"window_ms":60000,"error_rate":0.06,"open_ms":180000}}
```
leo: Canary plan: warmers run immediately after deploy (0m), staging 10% traffic for 4h, prod 5% for 6h then 25% if stable. Also auto-rollback if synthetic P99 > baseline*1.25 for 3 consecutive runs. Cron warmup at 02:05 UTC for frequently used models.
mira: Vendor outreach: emailed partner-ops@vendor.example asking for burst policy, emergency contact, and a sandbox token endpoint. Also requested SLA excerpts for rate-limits.
harper: Ops/telemetry: who will add dashboards and regression alerts? Need synthetic check every 5m, and an automated P99 drift alert that pages if >20% rise for 3 checks.
zach: I'll own telemetry wiring. Plan: create a dashboard card, add synthetic check (5m), and an alert runbook mapping to INF-10421. Also add cost monitor for warmers.
leo: Note on tradeoffs: prefetch/warmers increase egress and memory. Put an automated cost estimate in the PR and flag tradeoff if >6% monthly delta.
mira: Security notes: KMS rotation for fallback key must be scheduled in low-traffic window; sec proposed 02:00-04:00 UTC Tue next week. I've requested confirmation.
harper: Action items (assign by EOD): 1) Add 1-line subtasks with owners and estimates to INF-10421; 2) Owners write runbook sections (indicators, rollback, contacts); 3) Zach add telemetry + synthetic checks; 4) Mira confirm vendor contacts + KMS window; 5) Schedule monthly 15m "vendor-fire-drill" for six months.
leo: I'll add the prefetch library PR and include a small chaos test that simulates 15% registry 429s.
zach: Quick test command I'll add to the harness: ```bash
# simulate burst                                                                          
python load_test.py --clients 200 --burst-rate 10 --endpoint /auth/refresh
```
ops-bot: Reminder: INF-10421 created, no subtasks estimated. Please add estimates.
harper: We'll do a 20m sync Thursday to confirm estimates and unblock sec. If you claimed an item, set yourself as assignee on INF-10421 and paste a one-line plan there. Keep long-form discussion in the ticket. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
